hero.description: An independent look at how the Ministry of Interior's services moved from the counter to the screen, and where the transformation is heading next.

items.label: Unified digital IDs issued through Absher
Worldwide in the World Bank GovTech Maturity Index

compare.heading: We used to go to the office. Now we do it on the phone
compare.text: A few years ago, renewing an ID or a driving licence meant taking time off work and waiting for your number in a service hall. Today the same request is done on Absher from home. Move the line to see the difference.
compare.before_alt: People waiting on seats in a government service hall
compare.after_alt: A phone showing the Absher app in the App Store

journey.heading: The Journey
journey.intro: Eleven pages follow the story from the national vision, through the platforms and sectors, to what comes next.

about.heading: About This Project
about.text: MOI Digital Evolution is an educational project. Every figure on the site carries its source and date, and announced plans are clearly separated from services that are already operating.
